points.description: States at least 4 valid objectives of IPv6 from the following (equivalent wording accepted): support billions of end-systems (large address space); reduce routing table size; simplified header / simpler protocol processing; increased security; support real-time traffic / quality of service (flow label, traffic class); multicasting; mobility (roaming); openness to future change (extension headers); coexistence with existing protocols.
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.5) if exactly 2 or 3 valid objectives are stated.
